newsitem.title: GUYANA: CRICKET-AZHARUDDIN COMNPLETES 5,000 RUNS IN TESTS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AZHARUDDIN COMNPLETES 5,000 RUNS IN TESTS.

text.p: Former captain Mohammad Azharuddin reached 5,000 runs in test cricket to provide the only highlight of the day as the fifth and final test between West Indies and India ground towards a draw on Monday.

Azharuddin reached the milestone in his 83rd test when he had scored 20. He added just 11 more runs before he was caught by wicketkeeper Courtney Browne off fast bowler Franklyn Rose after sharing in a partnership of 49 for the fifth wicket with Nayan Mongia.
His was the only wicket to fall as India took their overnight 241 for four to 301 for five on the final day of this rain-hit match.
With the match holding nothing more than academic interest, India, 1-0 down in the five-match series, appeared bent on batting for as long as possible.
Mongia was unbeaten on 13 at the interval and Anil Kumble 14.
